info.title: Rewarded Ads Platform API
info.description:
REST API for the Rewarded Advertising Platform (Ethiopia).

All routes are prefixed with `/api/v1` (except /health).
Errors use the envelope `{ statusCode, code, message, details? }` where `code` is a stable value from `@rap/shared` `ErrorCode`.
List endpoints accept `?page&limit` and return `{ data, meta: { page, limit, total } }`.
Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC; ids are UUIDs; ETB amounts are numbers with 2 decimals; coins are integers.

phoneNumber.description: Ethiopian mobile number (09.., 07.., +2519.., 2517..). Normalised server-side to +251XXXXXXXXX.

deviceFingerprint.description: Device fingerprint hash collected by the client.

referralCode.description: Referral code of the inviting user; honoured only on the FIRST login of a new account.

dateOfBirth.description: Gregorian date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD. Provide EITHER this OR dateOfBirthEthiopian.

dateOfBirthEthiopian.description: Ethiopian calendar date of birth; converted and validated server-side (Pagume / leap-year rules).

password.description: Min 8 characters with at least one letter and one digit.

termsVersion.description: Advertiser terms version accepted at registration (GET /legal/current?audience=advertiser).

newPassword.description: Min 8 characters with at least one letter and one digit.

trustScoreDelta.description: Signed trust-score change to apply immediately

deviceFingerprint.description: Stable device fingerprint hash computed by the client (required for fraud checks).

positionSeconds.description: Current player position in seconds (informational only; the server uses its own clock).

attentionAnswerIndex.description: Index of the selected option when an attention question was returned at session start.

value.description: string (text / option index), string[] (multi choice) or number (rating).

proof.description: Optional attribution token / proof stored for manual verification

budgetEtb.description: Total budget in ETB (>= MIN_CAMPAIGN_BUDGET_ETB); reserved from the wallet when the campaign is submitted.

costPerActionEtb.description: Amount the advertiser pays per valid action (>= MIN_COST_PER_ACTION_ETB). User reward = cost x (1 - take rate).

attentionCheckEnabled.description: Ask a one-question attention check after each ad (default true).

frequencyCapPerUserPerDay.description: Max rewarded completions of this campaign per user per UTC day (1-5; default DEFAULT_FREQUENCY_CAP).
Max rewarded completions of this campaign per user per UTC day (1-5; default DEFAULT_FREQUENCY_CAP).
